# NoWeather

**Category:** Render  
**Aliases:** NoWeather

## What it does

Allows you to alter the client-side weather, time and moon phase.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://github.com/Wurst-Imperium/Wurst7/blob/4fa258b7b339f1823e73ae8455c404209e3690cd/src/main/resources/assets/wurst/translations/en_us.json). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).

## Client variants

### [Wurst — NoWeather](https://github.com/Wurst-Imperium/Wurst7/blob/4fa258b7b339f1823e73ae8455c404209e3690cd/src/main/java/net/wurstclient/hacks/NoWeatherHack.java)

Allows you to alter the client-side weather, time and moon phase.

Basis: [publisher description](https://github.com/Wurst-Imperium/Wurst7/blob/4fa258b7b339f1823e73ae8455c404209e3690cd/src/main/resources/assets/wurst/translations/en_us.json).

### [Future — NoWeather](https://www.futureclient.net/#features)

Allows you to disable game weather effects.

Basis: [publisher description](https://www.futureclient.net/#features).
